_comment: Canonical authored record of the 24 anchor-set prompts (8 each at n=2/3/4) -- ids 0-17 are the original set, 18-23 a 2026-07-24 growth batch on new, previously-unused subject combinations from the SAME controlled vocabulary (no new subjects/attributes, so the growth batch is not a confound). Subjects and attributes reuse the validated vocabulary from pi_level_experiment/generate_chains.py's MECHANISM_PROMPTS so token lookup, phrasing, and detectability stay in the regime already exercised there. Each prompt uses DISTINCT subjects and DISTINCT attributes. generate_anchor_images.py and generate_anchor_images_sdxl.py both embed an identical ANCHOR_PROMPTS literal (self-contained for the single-file Kaggle kernel) -- kept in sync even though the growth batch (18-23) is only actually GENERATED by the SDXL script (SDXL is the canonical model going forward; see CLAUDE.md). Downstream stages read the self-describing manifest.json, not this file, so this file is the human-facing source of truth, not a runtime dependency. The prompt's intended pairing is NOT ground truth -- the human label on the rendered pixels is.
